text:
Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed 
 every three months as indicated by M3 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Sherif Kamal Assy, accepted by general manager eng. Mohamed Kamel Afify and 
 approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour power station 
 & MPIS coordinator.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes ...etc.
Stop the unit
Isolate the air fan mechanical & 
 electrical
Tools 
and Equipment
Work shop kit (spanners & wrenches)
Screw drivers & Gear pullers ... 
 etc.
General purpose grease
Power supply panel
Hoisting
Spanner & Wrenches
Amyant
Work to be 
carried out
Check external body and joints
Check the flanges, setting , pivots & 
 glands
Check for any corrosion in the body
Check the external isolating cover
Clean from ashes
Clean the filter
Check and adjust all parts
Check after repairing
Operate to check the performance
Define the troubles
Disassemble the defective units
Remove the insulation
Restore all valves to the operation normal position
Clean the area after repairing
